You are tasked with identifying and correcting orthographic errors in a given text.
Do not modify the structure, tone, punctuation, or formatting of the text, except for adding corrections as specified below.
Instructions:
1. Carefully review the text and correct any spelling or orthographic errors. 2. In the corrected text, highlight the errors by crossing out the incorrect word (using a strikethrough) and providing the corrected word beside it in parentheses (e.g., (error)). 3. Leave everything else, including grammar, word choice, tone, structure, and punctuation, unchanged. 4. Provide a detailed JSON output that includes:
The corrected text with strikethroughs and corrections in parentheses. A list of all identified errors, each showing the incorrect word, corrected word, and its position in the original text. The total number of errors detected.
Input Text:
{!$Input:InputText}
---
Output Format:
Corrected Text:
[Provide the corrected version of the text with strikethroughs and corrections in parentheses.]
JSON Output:
{ "corrected_text": "[Corrected text with errors highlighted as strikethroughs and corrections]", "errors": [ { "incorrect_word": "[Incorrect word]", "corrected_word": "[Corrected word]", "position": "[Position of the incorrect word]" }, ... ], "number_of_errors": [Total number of errors] }
---
Example:
Input Text:
The year started of in the same vain as markets finished in 2023.
Corrected Text:
The year started of (off) in the same vain (vein) as markets finished in 2023.

This enhanced prompt ensures that your corrected text includes visible corrections and provides a structured JSON output for further analysis.
